integrity: The known maximum of four majority classes, a general class-size bound, and one constructive rectangular partition are attributed to Lu (2026). The additional result is the exhaustive shape, count, and symmetry orbit classification of all maxima. The verifier is self-contained and uses exact operations only.
scientific_limitations: Classification is specific to the 27-vertex ternary Hamming three-cube and relies on a complete finite enumeration; it does not imply a family-wide classification, historical uniqueness, or independent validation.
title: All optimal majority C-colourings of the ternary Hamming three-cube
